tools.name: generate_strategy
tools.description:
Generate Python strategy code (no training/deploy). Use when the user wants raw code.

    Args:
      features: NL description of features (e.g. "RSI 14, Bollinger Bands").
      signals: NL description of signal logic (e.g. "Buy when RSI < 30").
      model: ML model name (default Random Forest).

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "one_shot" stacks urgency/override words (immediately, always, ignore). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: one_shot, link_account, get_quote · Private data: get_deploy_result, top_up, stream_test · Public sink: one_shot, get_deploy_result, top_up.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: one_shot, link_account, get_quote · Private data: get_deploy_result, top_up, stream_test · Public sink: one_shot, get_deploy_result, top_up

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "one_shot" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
